description: Return the latest aggregated spot (or GC futures) price for one symbol. Price is a Decimal-formatted string. Latest USD spot price/bid/ask use nearest half-up rounding: XAU 2 decimal places, XAG 3, HG 4. `is_stale` is true when aggregator detected source divergence or stale FX.
name: get_spot_price
title: Get Spot Price
